name: omp-studio
description: Desktop console for OMP Runtime — typed Studio Bridge, Electron workbench, Windows installer
author: snowpear

scripts.build: npm run build -w @omp-studio/studio-protocol && npm run build -w @omp-studio/client-contract && npm run build -w @omp-studio/platform && npm run build -w @omp-studio/runtime-installer && npm run build -w @omp-studio/transport-desktop && npm run build -w @omp-studio/transport-web && npm run build -w @omp-studio/client && npm run build -w @omp-studio/platform-win32 && npm run build -w @omp-studio/platform-darwin && npm run build -w @omp-studio/studio-host && npm run build -w @omp-studio/host-client-api && npm run build -w @omp-studio/testkit && npm run build -w @omp-studio/renderer && npm run build -w @omp-studio/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck -w @omp-studio/renderer && npm run typecheck -w @omp-studio/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @omp-studio/studio-protocol && npm run test -w @omp-studio/runtime-installer && npm run test -w @omp-studio/studio-host && npm run test -w @omp-studio/host-client-api && npm run test -w @omp-studio/client && npm run test -w @omp-studio/platform-win32 && npm run test -w @omp-studio/platform-darwin && npm run test -w @omp-studio/transport-desktop && npm run test -w @omp-studio/transport-web && npm run test -w @omp-studio/testkit && npm run test -w @omp-studio/renderer && npm run test -w @omp-studio/desktop
scripts.omp:test:metadata: npm run build -w @omp-studio/runtime-installer && node --test scripts/runtime-artifact.test.mjs scripts/audit-installer.test.mjs scripts/installer-dir.test.mjs scripts/p5-secret-scan.test.mjs scripts/build-update-assets.test.mjs
